package rulefixtures

import (
	"errors"
)

// scenario for not_found_semantics_implemented_by_nil_nil_return: Repository or service APIs that encode missing records as `nil, nil` with no explicit result contract.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

type User struct {
	ID   int
	Name string
}

type UserRepository struct{}

func (r *UserRepository) FindByID(id int) (*User, error) {
	if id <= 0 {
		return nil, nil
	}
	return &User{ID: id, Name: "Alice"}, nil
}

type UserService struct {
	repo *UserRepository
}

func (s *UserService) GetUser(id int) (*User, error) {
	user, err := s.repo.FindByID(id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if user == nil && err == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("ambiguous: no user and no error")
	}
	return user, nil
}
